name: Fire Bolt
Description: Launches a small bolt of fire at a single target. Basic fire spell for beginners.

name: Fireball
Description: Hurls an exploding sphere of fire that damages all enemies in the blast radius.

name: Fire Wall
Description: Creates a wall of flames that burns enemies who pass through it.

name: Fire Storm
Description: Calls down a devastating rain of fire from the sky, incinerating all in the area.

name: Meteor Strike
Description: Summons a massive meteor from the heavens to obliterate everything below.

name: Flame Lash
Description: Whips a tendril of fire at an enemy, searing their flesh.

name: Inferno
Description: Engulf an area in a raging inferno that持续 burns all caught within.

name: Ice Bolt
Description: Fires a shard of ice that pierces the target and chills them.

name: Ice Storm
Description: Conjures a localized blizzard that pelts enemies with jagged ice.

name: Frost Nova
Description: Releases a burst of frost in all directions, freezing nearby enemies solid.

name: Blizzard
Description: Summons a massive blizzard that engulfs the battlefield in howling winds and ice.

name: Glacial Spike
Description: Forms a massive spear of ice and launches it at a single target with devastating force.

name: Frozen Orb
Description: Creates an orb of concentrated frost that drifts toward enemies, slowing and damaging them.

name: Lightning Bolt
Description: Calls down a jagged bolt of lightning to strike a single enemy.

name: Chain Lightning
Description: Launches lightning that arcs between multiple enemies, weakening as it jumps.

name: Thunderclap
Description: Creates a deafening clap of thunder that stuns nearby foes.

name: Storm Caller
Description: Commands the sky itself to unleash a furious barrage of lightning upon enemies.

name: Static Field
Description: Generates a field of static energy that drains a portion of nearby enemies' life force.

name: Shockwave
Description: Sends a powerful tremor through the ground that knocks enemies off balance.

name: Earthquake
Description: Shakes the earth violently, causing massive damage and toppling all in the area.

name: Rock Shard
Description: Rips a jagged stone from the ground and hurls it at a target.

name: Mudslide
Description: Unleashes a torrent of mud and debris that engulfs enemies.

name: Stone Fist
Description: Encases your fist in stone and delivers a crushing blow that stuns.

name: Avalanche
Description: Calls down a massive cascade of rocks and boulders upon your enemies.

name: Tornado
Description: Creates a spinning vortex of wind that pulls enemies in and tears them apart.

name: Chain Lightning (Enhanced)
Description: An improved chain lightning that leaps between more targets with less damage loss.

name: Chaos Bolt
Description: Hurls a bolt of pure chaotic energy that manifests as a random element.

name: Minor Heal
Description: A basic healing spell that mends minor wounds.

name: Heal
Description: Channels divine energy to heal a target's wounds.

name: Greater Heal
Description: A powerful healing spell that can mend even grievous injuries.

name: Divine Heal
Description: Calls upon divine power to completely restore a target's vitality.

name: Healing Touch
Description: A direct healing touch that channels restorative energy through your hands.

name: Regeneration
Description: Infuses a target with restorative energy that heals them over time.

name: Greater Regeneration
Description: An enhanced regeneration spell that heals rapidly over a longer duration.

name: Purify
Description: Cleanses a target of poisons, curses, and magical ailments.

name: Cleanse
Damage/Effect: Removes all debuffs + grants debuff immunity 3s
Description: Thoroughly cleanses a target, removing all negative effects temporarily.

name: Resurrection
Description: Returns a fallen ally from death with half their vitality restored.

name: Phoenix Rebirth
Damage/Effect: Revives target with full HP + fire aura 5s
Description: Brings an ally back from death with full power and a protective fire aura.

name: Holy Shield
Description: Surrounds a target with a barrier of divine light that absorbs damage.

name: Divine Shield
Description: Encases a target in impenetrable divine light, making them immune to all damage.

name: Smite
Description: Calls down holy light to burn undead and demonic creatures.

name: Radiance
Description: Emits a brilliant aura that damages enemies and heals nearby allies.

name: Prayer of Healing
Description: Offers a prayer that channels healing energy to all wounded allies in range.

name: Lay on Hands
Damage/Effect: Heals target for caster's max HP
Description: Transfers your own life force to fully heal a target, at great personal cost.

name: Sanctified Ground
Description: Consecrates an area of ground, healing all allies who stand upon it.

name: Lightbringer
Description: Calls down a pillar of pure light that sears enemies and blinds them.

name: Mending
Description: Channels restorative magic to repair damaged equipment in the field.

name: Summon Familiar
Description: Calls forth a minor spirit creature to assist you in battle.

name: Summon Wolf
Description: Conjures a spectral wolf that fights alongside you.

name: Summon Elemental
Description: Calls forth an elemental spirit of considerable power.

name: Summon Golem
Damage/Effect: Summons a stone golem (8d6+12 damage, high armor)
Description: Animates stone into a massive guardian that fights with brute strength.

name: Create Water
Description: Conjures clean, drinkable water from thin air.

name: Conjure Weapon
Description: Manifests a spectral weapon of pure magical energy.

name: Conjure Armor
Description: Summons magical armor that provides protection without weight.

name: Conjure Food
Damage/Effect: Creates a meal that restores 50 hunger
Description: Manifests a nourishing meal from magical energy.

name: Phantasmal Force
Damage/Effect: Creates an illusory threat that distracts target
Description: Creates a believable illusion that occupies the target's attention.

name: Minor Illusion
Description: Creates a simple illusion of an object or sound.

name: Glyph of Warding
Damage/Effect: Creates a trap that deals 6d8+10 damage when triggered
Description: Inscribes a magical glyph that detonates when an enemy approaches.

name: Summon Swarm
Damage/Effect: Summons insects that deal 2d4 damage per second
Description: Conjures a cloud of biting insects that harass enemies.

name: Arcane Familiar
Damage/Effect: Summons an arcane sprite (4d6+6 damage + mana regen)
Description: Creates a small arcane construct that attacks enemies and restores mana.

name: Mirror Image
Description: Creates illusory duplicates of yourself to confuse enemies.

name: Elemental Confluence
Description: Calls forth three different elementals to fight as a powerful group.

name: Teleport
Damage/Effect: Instantly moves caster to target location
Description: Bends space to instantly transport yourself to a visible location.

name: Greater Teleport
Description: Teleports you to any location you have previously visited.

name: Haste
Description: Accelerates time around a target, making them move and act faster.

name: Slow
Description: Decelerates time around a target, hindering their movements.

name: Polymorph: Sheep
Damage/Effect: Transforms enemy into a harmless sheep
Description: Transforms a humanoid enemy into a docile sheep.

name: Polymorph: Bear
Damage/Effect: Transforms ally into a bear (+50% HP, +30% damage)
Description: Transforms an ally into a powerful bear, greatly enhancing their combat abilities.

name: Leaden Feet
Damage/Effect: Roots target in place for 5 seconds
Description: Causes a target's feet to become impossibly heavy, rooting them.

name: Featherfall
Description: Wraps a target in air magic, allowing them to fall safely from any height.

name: Stone Skin
Description: Hardens your skin to the consistency of stone, greatly increasing defense.

name: Iron Maiden
Damage/Effect: Encases target in iron, dealing 3d8 damage + immobilize 4s
Description: Encases a target in a shell of iron, crushing and immobilizing them.

name: Shrink
Damage/Effect: Reduces target size by 50% (-40% damage, -30% HP)
Description: Diminishes a target's physical form, reducing their power.

name: Enlarge
Damage/Effect: Increases target size by 50% (+40% damage, +30% HP)
Description: Augments a target's physical form, making them larger and more powerful.

name: Blink
Description: Instantly teleports a short distance in the direction you're facing.

name: Time Warp
Description: Bends time to grant an ally an additional turn in combat.

name: Dimensional Anchor
Damage/Effect: Prevents target from teleporting for 15 seconds
Description: Anchors a target to the current plane, preventing dimensional travel.

name: Transmute Metal
Damage/Effect: Transmutes metal into another type (iron→silver, etc.)
Description: Alters the molecular structure of metal, changing its properties.

name: Gravity Well
Damage/Effect: Pulls all enemies to center point + 4d8 damage
Description: Creates a localized gravity distortion that pulls enemies together.

name: Invisibility
Description: Bends light around you, rendering you invisible until you act.

name: Greater Invisibility
Description: Maintains invisibility even while engaging in combat.

name: Charm Person
Damage/Effect: Charms humanoid target to fight for you
Description: Enthralls a humanoid, making them regard you as a trusted ally.

name: Mass Charm
Description: Extends charm magic to enthrall multiple humanoid targets simultaneously.

name: Fear
Damage/Effect: Causes target to flee in terror
Description: Projects a terrifying image that causes the target to flee.

name: Mass Fear
Damage/Effect: Causes all enemies in area to flee
Description: Releases a wave of terror that causes all nearby enemies to flee.

name: Hallucination
Description: Creates vivid hallucinations that impair the target's ability to fight.

name: Mirror Image
Description: Creates perfect duplicates of yourself that confuse enemies.

name: Confusion
Description: Magically confuses a target, causing them to attack indiscriminately.

name: Sleep
Description: Lulls a target into a magical slumber.

name: Nightshade
Description: Creates an aura of shadow that clouds the target's vision.

name: Phantasmal Killer
Damage/Effect: Target faces their worst fear (8d10 psychic damage)
Description: Forces a target to confront a vision of their greatest fear, dealing psychic damage.

name: Mind Blank
Description: Shields your mind from all magical intrusion and mind control.

name: Deceive
Damage/Effect: Target perceives caster as an ally
Description: Projects a false image that makes you appear as an ally to the target.

name: Psychic Scream
Description: Unleashes a burst of psychic energy that damages and stuns nearby foes.

name: Shadow Step
Damage/Effect: Teleport through shadows + next attack deals +50% damage
Description: Steps through the shadows to reappear behind an enemy, ready to strike.

name: Life Drain
Damage/Effect: 3d6+4 shadow damage + heal for 50% damage dealt
Description: Siphons life force from a target, healing yourself.

name: Death Coil
Damage/Effect: 5d8+10 shadow damage + heal for 50% on living
Description: Launches a bolt of necrotic energy that damages living targets or heals undead.

name: Raise Dead
Damage/Effect: Raises a corpse as an undead minion (4d6+6 damage)
Description: Reanimates a corpse to fight as your undead servant.

name: Raise Skeleton
Description: Reassembles bones into a skeletal warrior that obeys your commands.

name: Raise Frost Wyrm
Damage/Effect: Raises a frost wyrm (8d8+15 damage + slow aura)
Description: Resurrects a mighty frost wyrm to serve as your most powerful undead servant.

name: Shadow Bolt
Description: Hurls a bolt of shadow energy that tears at the target's life force.

name: Shadow Nova
Description: Releases an explosion of shadow energy that damages all nearby enemies.

name: Soul Harvest
Damage/Effect: Deals 4d8+8 shadow damage + restore 30 mana per kill
Description: Drains the soul of a dying enemy to replenish your mana.

name: Dark Pact
Damage/Effect: Sacrifice 20% current HP to restore 40% max mana
Description: Strikes a deal with dark forces, trading life force for magical power.

name: Curse of Weakness
Description: Places a curse on a target that saps their strength.

name: Curse of Agony
Description: Inflicts a lingering curse that causes escalating pain over time.

name: Vampiric Touch
Description: Channels vampiric energy through your touch, draining life from the target.

name: Death and Decay
Description: Corrupts an area with necrotic energy, causing all within to wither and die.

name: Bone Shield
Damage/Effect: Creates a shield of bones (absorbs 40 + 4×level damage)
Description: Summons a swirling barrier of bone fragments that deflects attacks.

name: Army of the Dead
Description: Summons a small army of undead warriors to overwhelm your enemies.

name: Lich Form
Damage/Effect: Transforms into a lich (+50% spell damage, +30% mana regen, immunity to crits)
Description: Transforms yourself into an undead lich, gaining immense power at a terrible cost.

name: Soul Rend
Damage/Effect: 6d8+10 shadow damage + reduce max HP by 10%
Description: Tears at the target's soul, dealing damage and reducing their maximum vitality.

name: Enchant Weapon
Description: Imbues a weapon with elemental energy, adding bonus damage.

name: Enchant Armor
Description: Imbues armor with protective enchantments that resist elemental damage.

name: Frost Enchant
Description: Coats a weapon in frost magic, chilling enemies on hit.

name: Fire Enchant
Damage/Effect: Weapon attacks deal 1d6 fire damage over 4s
Description: Infuses a weapon with flame, causing enemies to burn on hit.

name: Lightning Enchant
Damage/Effect: Weapon attacks have 15% chance to stun 1s
Description: Charges a weapon with lightning, occasionally stunning enemies.

name: Spell Power
Description: Enchants yourself to channel more power through your spells.

name: Mana Shield
Damage/Effect: Converts 50% of damage taken to mana cost
Description: Creates a barrier that converts incoming damage into mana expenditure.

name: Arcane Intellect
Description: Enchants a target with arcane wisdom, boosting their intelligence.

name: Blessing of Might
Description: Enchants a target with physical power, boosting their strength.

name: Blessing of Agility
Description: Enchants a target with supernatural agility and reflexes.

name: Mana Burn
Damage/Effect: Burns 20% of target's max mana + 1d6 damage per mana burned
Description: Detonates a target's mana reserves, dealing damage based on mana lost.

name: Spell Reflection
Damage/Effect: Reflects the next spell cast at you
Description: Creates a mirror-like barrier that reflects incoming spells back at the caster.

name: Rune of Power
Damage/Effect: Creates a zone that buffs allies (+20% damage, +10% crit)
Description: Inscribes a powerful rune on the ground that empowers all allies within.

name: Disenchant
Damage/Effect: Removes magical effects from a target
Description: Strips away magical enchantments from a target or item.

name: Feedback
Damage/Effect: Deals 1 damage per point of target's mana + stuns if mana > 50%
Description: Converts a target's mana into raw damage, punishing mana-heavy casters.

name: Power Word: Fortify
Damage/Effect: Grants +20% max HP and immunity to crits
Description: Speaks a word of power that greatly fortifies a target's physical form.
